subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_in: Goku: "Hey! I'm Son Goku. Let's have a great fight!"
Goku: "Wow, you look strong! This is going to be fun!"
Goku: "I've been waiting for someone like you!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_fo: Goku: "Not bad! Now it gets real!"
Goku: "Hah... this takes a lot out of me. Better end it fast!"
Goku: "A calm, divine power... Super Saiyan God."
Goku: "Kaio-ken times ten, on top of Blue!"
Goku: "Kaio-ken! My body can take it!"
Goku: "My body... is moving by itself."
Goku: "Whoa, what is this feeling? It's amazing!"
Goku: "This is it. Perfected Ultra Instinct."
Goku: "True Ultra Instinct. Come on, give me everything!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_sp: Goku: "Just a little more... Spirit Bomb!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_ca: Goku: "Zanzoken! Can you keep up with me?"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_di: Goku: "Here, catch! It comes right back!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_hu: Goku: "Heh, you got me good there!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_do: Goku: "Whoa, my body moved on its own!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_lo: Goku: "Phew... I'm running low. But I'm not done yet!"
Goku: "Haa... haa... this is the best part!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_pl: Goku: "Oh no, did I go too far? Sorry!"
Goku: "Hey! You okay? Man, I overdid it."
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_vi: Goku: "That was a good fight! Come back when you're stronger!"
Goku: "Huh? Come on, get up! Let's go again later."
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.goku_de: Goku: "Heh... that was a great fight. Thanks."
Goku: "I haven't felt this alive in years!"
Goku: "You win. Let's do this again sometime!"
subtitles.anime_multiverse.voice.sinbad_: Sinbad: "So, you came all this way to meet me. How flattering."
Sinbad: "Let me show you what the King of the Seven Seas can do."
Sinbad: "An adventure at last. Shall we begin?"
Sinbad: "Spirit of Wrath and Heroes, Baal! Dwell in my body: Djinn Equip!"
Sinbad: "Come forth, Baal!"
Sinbad: "Spirit of Falsehood and Confidence, Valefor! Dwell in my body!"
Sinbad: "Valefor, lend me your cunning!"
Sinbad: "Spirit of Spirit and Puppetry, Zepar! Dwell in my body!"
Sinbad: "Zepar, make them listen."
Sinbad: "Spirit of Control and Obedience, Focalor! Dwell in my body!"
Sinbad: "Focalor, carry me on the wind!"
Sinbad: "Vepar! Dwell in my body, and draw every blade to me!"
Sinbad: "Vepar, rain steel on my enemies."
Sinbad: "Crocell! Dwell in my body, and let your light cut through!"
Sinbad: "Crocell, shine for me!"
Sinbad: "Furfur! Dwell in my body, and tear the darkness open!"
Sinbad: "Furfur... come."
Sinbad: "That is enough of that, for now."
Sinbad: "Rest, my djinn."
Sinbad: "Allow me."
Sinbad: "A simple blade is enough for you."
Sinbad: "Your magic means nothing to me. Magoi Manipulation."
Sinbad: "I will take that power from you."
Sinbad: "Bararaq Saiqa!"
Sinbad: "Lightning, answer me! Bararaq!"
Sinbad: "Bararaq... Inqerad-Saiqa!"
Sinbad: "Stand in the light, or be struck down!"
Sinbad: "Garufor Zairu!"
Sinbad: "Garufor Kirestal! Freeze!"
Sinbad: "Everything slows. Everything stops."
Sinbad: "Be still."
Sinbad: "Look away, if you value your mind!"
Sinbad: "Sleep!"
Sinbad: "Foraz Zora!"
Sinbad: "Two storms, become one!"
Sinbad: "Vepar Istella! A thousand swords!"
Sinbad: "Fall, blades of steel!"
Sinbad: "Three cuts, and not one you will see."
Sinbad: "Crocell's saber, hah!"
Sinbad: "Rend the dark!"
Sinbad: "Darkness, open wide."
Sinbad: "Seven djinn, seven lights. Fly, my Rukh!"
Sinbad: "The Rukh love me. Let them show you."
Sinbad: "This circle is my kingdom. Choose where you stand."
Sinbad: "Only the dark is safe here."
Sinbad: "Seven Seas, answer your king!"
Sinbad: "All seven, together!"
Sinbad: "I already saw that coming."
Sinbad: "The flow of destiny never lies."
Sinbad: "Enough games. I will use every djinn I have."
Sinbad: "Do not make me regret taking you seriously."
Sinbad: "Ha! Now that stung."
Sinbad: "Careful. A king bleeds too."
Sinbad: "Not yet. A king never kneels first."
Sinbad: "My Household would never forgive me for losing here."
Sinbad: "Is that all? Come, impress me."
Sinbad: "You fight well. Almost as well as I sail."
Sinbad: "Do not stop now. I am just warming up."
Sinbad: "A pity. You had courage."
Sinbad: "Rest well. The sea remembers brave ones."
Sinbad: "The Seven Seas are mine. Try again someday."
Sinbad: "A fine fight. Go home and train."
Sinbad: "Well fought. The sea has taken me, this time."
Sinbad: "You are stronger than I judged. I will not forget it."
Sinbad: "So this is how a king falls. Worth it."
